title: Understanding Mean Nearest Squared Error
text: Think about how the mean nearest squared error is calculated. It involves finding the squared distances from each observation to the nearest point on the regression line. How does this differ from the mean squared error, which considers the vertical distance to the line?

title: Comparing Distances
text: Consider the difference between the vertical distance and the perpendicular distance from a point to a line. Which one is generally shorter?

title: Choosing the Correct Comparison
